posts.body:
Hi everyone,
This is the skills menu of RPG Maker MZ with the Visustella plugins. Here you can find information about the skill, but I want to change some names and I can't find where these parameters are in the plugin. Does anyone know? I've been going crazy looking for them.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
mike_312 said:
I can't find where these parameters are in the plugin. Does anyone know?
Click to expand...
Well...you don't provide a link to the plugin you're using, nor even the actual name.
As I recall from the last time someone had this issue, they're not all in the same plugin, so check the parameters in all menu- and skill-related plugins.
